summary: Marinette County, WI 100-foot tower built October 1939 for the WDNR; state retired towers in 2015 and the county took liability; FFLA lists it as gone.

facts.design: 100-foot Wisconsin standard tower with an external protected ladder
facts.status_note: FFLA's Wisconsin list marks the tower as gone; no removal date or description of the site today found in sources read

events.note: Built October 1939 per NHLR. A 1954 USGS survey description on the Forest Lookouts page refers to a Middle Inlet tower with 1935 attached; unresolved
DNR decommissioned fire watch towers across the state; the Marinette County towers near Cedarville and Middle Inlet were part of that decision
Marinette County Forestry and Parks Committee approved a plan to remove the fire towers (Bay Cities Online article dated February 5, 2016, quoted on Forest Lookouts)
Registered June 9, 2017; nominated by Tyler Bormann

notes_for_editor: Built date October 1939 (NHLR) conflicts with a 1935 'Middle Inlet Tower' reference in a 1954 USGS survey description quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. Left unresolved; the story says so and keeps the register date. 'Gone' rests on the FFA list alone; no removal date or current site description found. The February 2016 item is a Bay Cities Online news article, read only through the Forest Lookouts quotation; the original was not fetched. No staffing or fire history found for this tower.
